title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a video model generates physically incorrect motion, did it fail to learn the correct motion, or did it learn it but fail to use it? We show the latter: the correct motion remains available inside the model and can still be made to control the generated video. We train on videos where red masses oscillate slowly and blue masses oscillate quickly, then test a red mass with fast observed motion. Even when the model generates slow motion in this conflicting case, a low-dimensional edit predicted from simple physical variables restores the correct fast motion. We call this ability causal writability. At fixed strength, we find a sharp depth boundary: the same edit changes the video before the boundary but not after it. This closure marks commitment for that write. The motion signal nevertheless remains, and a stronger downstream write can restore physical motion, while excessive gain overshoots. translated_title: 已选定的未来仍可被重写：视频模型中的因果可写性
translated_abstract: 当视频模型生成物理上不正确的运动时，它究竟是未能学到正确的运动，还是学到了却未能使用？我们证明了后者：正确的运动信息仍然存在于模型内部，并且仍然可以使其控制生成的视频。我们在红色物体缓慢振荡、蓝色物体快速振荡的视频上训练模型，然后测试一个具有快速观测运动的红色物体。即使模型在这种冲突情况下生成了缓慢的运动，一个由简单物理变量预测出的低维编辑也能恢复正确的快速运动。我们将这种能力称为“因果可写性”。在固定强度下，我们发现了一个清晰的深度边界：相同的编辑在边界之前会改变视频，但在边界之后则不再起作用。这种闭合标志着该次写入的“承诺点”。然而运动信号依然保留，更强的下游写入可以恢复物理上正确的运动，而过大的增益则会导致过冲。早期的因果可写性可以预测哪些……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“因果可写性”概念，证明视频模型即使生成物理错误的运动，正确的运动信息仍保留在模型内部，可通过简单低维编辑在特定深度边界之前重写生成结果，且更强的编辑仍可在更深层恢复正确的物理运动。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "causal writability," showing that even when video models generate physically incorrect motion, the correct motion remains accessible inside the model and can be restored via simple low-dimensional edits before a sharp depth boundary, with stronger downstream writes still effective at deeper layers.
